I am an old woman farming my small rice plot here in Ruvuma. The rains here are good for rice, but I do not have much money for fertilizer — maybe I can buy a small bag of urea to topdress when the rice is growing, but DAP is too expensive for me. I will use the seed I saved from last year like I always do, and my children will help me with the weeding and harvest, though I may need to hire a few people for transplanting since my back is not what it used to be.
